# Third-party code

`libusb/` contains the unmodified libusb 1.0.30 header and Windows x64 DLL/import
library, with license and download/hash records. No vendored AA protocol sources.
Current Qt binaries are supplied through the
external SDK. Before adopting AASDK or another project, pin its exact commit,
preserve copyright/license notices, record local patches and add reproducible
dependency configuration. See `../docs/android_auto.md` and `../docs/dependencies.md`.
